name: Sunpetal
lore: A sunlit garden guardian who followed a lost dawn to the Crossroads.

primary.name: Bullet Seed
primary.description: Fire four seeds consecutively along your aim in a short burst. Each deals 5 damage; equipment bonuses are divided across the burst.

secondary.name: Kindle Bloom
secondary.description: Lob a seed at your aimed spot. It plants, blooms after 3 seconds, then fires 8-damage fireballs at nearby enemies and heals you/allies for 3 HP per second within 140 units for 8 seconds. Maximum two plants per hero.

special.name: Solarbeam
special.description: Charge for 2.5 seconds, then fire a wide beam for 120 damage. Move slowly while charging; stunning interrupts it.

passive: Sun-fed: recover 4 health after defeating an enemy.

technique.name: Focused Sun
technique.description: Charge Solarbeam 30% faster, but fire a 35% narrower beam.

final_technique.name: Sunthorn
final_technique.description: A slim charged sunthorn pierces a lane for 19 damage. Replaces the four-seed burst; stronger single hit but slower and narrower.

attack.name: Sunthorn
attack.description: A slim charged sunthorn pierces a lane for 19 damage. Replaces the four-seed burst; stronger single hit but slower and narrower.
